tool.name: cgMLST filtering and clustering
tool.description: filter ChewBBACA cgMLST allele profiles and generate distance data and a dendrogram

param.name: input
param.label: ChewBBACA allele call results file
param.help: Input allele profile matrix, namely the ChewBBACA results_alleles.tsv file.

param.name: max_missing
param.label: Maximum number of missing alleles
param.help: Samples with more than this number of missing alleles will be removed before clustering.

param.name: clustering_method
param.label: Clustering method
param.help: Choose the method used to generate the Newick tree.

tool.help:
**What it does**
This tool filters and clusters ChewBBACA cgMLST allele call results.
It removes samples with more than the selected number of missing alleles, calculates pairwise allele differences, and generates a dendrogram.
**Input**
A ChewBBACA allele profile matrix, ``results_alleles.tsv``.
**Maximum number of missing alleles**
Samples with more than this number of missing alleles are removed before clustering.
**Clustering method**
- ``single``: single-linkage hierarchical clustering - ``nj``: neighbor joining
**Outputs**
- Dissimilarity matrix - Hamming distance table - cgMLST tree in Newick format
